app.name: MindNode - Mind Map & Outline
app.description: A mind mapping and outlining app for iOS that helps you visualize ideas and organize thoughts.

verdict.one_liner: MindNode is a privacy-conscious mind mapping app with end-to-end encrypted collaboration and strong GDPR compliance, though it collects device identifiers and shares data with named service providers.
verdict.summary: MindNode - Mind Map & Outline by IdeasOnCanvas GmbH is a productivity app with notably strong privacy practices. Its live collaboration feature uses end-to-end encryption, meaning the company cannot read your mind maps. The privacy policy is transparent, naming every third-party processor and explaining GDPR legal bases. However, the app collects device identifiers and hashed serial numbers for licensing, and shares data with several service providers including some US-based companies covered by EU adequacy decisions.
verdict.recommendation_reason: MindNode has excellent privacy fundamentals with end-to-end encryption, no ads, no data selling, and transparent GDPR compliance. Be aware that device identifiers are collected at launch and data is shared with named processors for app functionality.

red.title: Device identifiers collected at launch
red.plain_english: The app collects your device model, hashed serial number on Mac, and a unique user identifier when you launch it for licensing and subscription verification.

red.title: Data kept for up to 7 years after you stop using the app
red.plain_english: MindNode stores purchase receipts and account data for up to 7 years for tax and legal reasons, even after you delete the app or cancel your subscription.

red.title: Some data processed by US-based companies
red.plain_english: Your data is handled by providers like Vercel and fly.io in the United States. While these transfers are covered by EU adequacy decisions, your data still leaves the European Economic Area.

green.title: Live collaboration is end-to-end encrypted
green.plain_english: When you collaborate on a mind map in real time, your document data is encrypted on your device and only decrypted on your collaborators' devices. The servers cannot read your content.

green.title: No ads or behavioral tracking
green.plain_english: MindNode doesn't show ads or track your behavior across apps and websites. Their website analytics use Plausible, which doesn't use cookies or track individual visitors.

green.title: Strong GDPR compliance with named processors
green.plain_english: MindNode clearly explains your rights under GDPR and names every company that processes your data, including what they do and where they are located.

green.title: Account is optional
green.plain_english: You can use MindNode without creating an account. An account is only needed if you want to sync your subscription across multiple platforms.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: MindNode does not access your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention camera or microphone access. As a mind mapping and outlining app, these permissions are not required for core functionality.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: MindNode does not track your location.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention location or GPS access. There is no feature in a mind mapping app that would require location data.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: MindNode does not access your contacts.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention contacts or phonebook access. Collaboration is done through the optional MindNode Live service, not via contacts import.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: MindNode stores your mind maps in iCloud or locally on your device. Only you control your files.
categories.detail: The app creates and stores mind map documents in its sandbox or in your personal iCloud account. The policy mentions document data being exchanged for live collaboration. There is no mention of broad file system scanning or external file access.
categories.policy_excerpt: The MindNode App will use a Service to exchange document data and transient metadata...

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: MindNode shares your data with several named service providers like Vercel, Mailjet, and fly.io to run their website, email, and collaboration services. They do not sell your data to advertisers or data brokers.
categories.detail: The policy lists specific processors: Vercel (web hosting, USA), fly.io (Live Service, USA), Mailjet (email, France), Heroku (webservice, USA), Plausible (analytics, Estonia), Hetzner (storage, Germany), World4You (web hosting, Austria), and Teamwork.com (helpdesk, Ireland). US providers are covered by adequacy decisions. Data is not sold to advertisers or brokers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Below you will find a list of all processors with the purposes of the processing...

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: If you create a MindNode Account, the app stores your email address and a hashed password. An account is optional and only needed to manage subscriptions across devices.
categories.detail: The optional MindNode Account requires an email address and password hash, both stored encrypted on the server. The email may be used for service notifications and support. App launch licensing also collects a user identifier, device model, and OS version.
categories.policy_excerpt: At registration for your MindNode, we store the email address and a hash generated from the password submitted to us. The email address and hash are stored encrypted on our server.
concerns: Optional account requires email and password

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: MindNode doesn't show ads or track you for advertising. Their website analytics are anonymous and cookie-free.
categories.detail: No advertising or behavioral tracking in the app. Website uses Plausible Analytics which is privacy-focused, cookie-free, and only collects anonymous aggregated data. The newsletter tracks opens and clicks but this is limited to their own opt-in email list and not cross-app tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you visit the MindNode Website, we collect some anonymous usage data for statistical purposes only. We don't track individual visitors and all the data is in aggregate only. No personal data is collected and no cookies are set for tracking or analytic purposes.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: MindNode doesn't knowingly collect data from children under 16.
categories.detail: The policy states they do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under the age of 16 and will delete such information if discovered.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under the age of 16. In case we learn that we have collected Personal Data of a child under the age of 16, we will delete that information as quickly as possible.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: MindNode logs basic server data like your IP address for security, but only keeps it for 20 days.
categories.detail: Server log files processed by Vercel include IP addresses, system configuration, timestamps, and referring URLs. Stored for 20 days for security and website operation. Website analytics via Plausible are anonymous and cookie-free. App internet activity is needed for the Live Service and subscription verification.
categories.policy_excerpt: For the above mentioned purposes, your information is processed based on § 165 para. 3 TKG 2021 and is stored for 20 days to ensure the operation of our website.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: MindNode collects basic device info like your device model and OS version to verify your subscription and license the app.
categories.detail: At app activation, the following are collected: model and version of device, hashed device serial number (Mac) or unique ID, OS version, app version, user identifier, and language. This is used for licensing and to show pop-up notices. Data is stored for up to 3 years after app deletion for legal claims.
categories.policy_excerpt: At activation of the app, as a technical requirement to run the service, we sync an universal unique identifier (UUID) between devices so you don't have to register at each device for our app separately.
concerns: Hashed device serial number collected on Mac

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: MindNode doesn't collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention health, fitness, or biometric data. As a mind mapping and outlining app, these data types are not relevant to its functionality.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: MindNode doesn't handle your payment info directly. Apple processes all purchases through the App Store.
categories.detail: App Store handles all payments. MindNode only receives digital purchase receipts from Apple containing purchase type, date, and app version at time of purchase. No credit card or banking details are collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: To manage and verify your subscription across multiple platforms, we collect your App Store digital purchase receipts, combine it with a generated unique device identifier and a pseudonymized identifier that is stored inside your iCloud account.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You have full GDPR rights including access, correction, deletion, and data export. Contact them at privacy@mindnode.com.
categories.detail: Section 15 outlines full GDPR rights (Art. 15-21). Users can request deletion by emailing privacy@mindnode.com. Data is retained for 7 years for tax obligations and 3 years after contract termination for legal claims, which is standard for business compliance.
categories.policy_excerpt: We would furthermore like to inform you that you have the right, at all times, to request information concerning whether or not personal data is being processed, as well as access to your personal data process (see Art. 15 GDPR for details).

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy includes a clear 'last updated' date. As a GDPR-compliant company, MindNode is legally required to inform you of material changes.
categories.detail: The policy footer states 'Last updated: November 25th, 2024'. Users can contact privacy@mindnode.com with concerns or questions about policy changes. As an EU-based company subject to GDPR, they are obligated to maintain transparent data processing practices.
